title: Touge King the Spirits 2
native_title: 峠キング・ザ・スピリッツ２
overview:
Take on Japan's winding mountain passes in this sequel to Touge King the Spirits. Go head-to-head against rival cars on twisting touge roads, where the tight corners demand control as much as raw speed. Before each battle, tune your car's setup - grip, brakes and gearing - to suit the course.

- 3D racing for 1 or 2 players
- Racing Controller and Sega Multi Controller compatible
- Memory backup support
